historical_source: Lilly Christian Astrology 1647 original printed738–741 and separate 1659 printed738–741

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: If Saturn in a Revolution returne to his owne place
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Well-affected Saturn at its own natal position purportedly indicates dignity and property; Midheaven placement strengthens the claim.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Requires favorable return-Saturn condition; Midheaven is an intensifier.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: When to the place of Jupiter
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Saturn returning to natal Jupiter is assigned favorable claims concerning body and goods.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No explicit additional prerequisite in this paragraph.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: When to the place of Mars
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of travel, lying and sibling difficulties.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Moral and family assertions are period rhetoric.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of the Sun at Birth
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of contention with powerful persons, property losses and physical complaints.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Old medical assertion not independently verified.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Venus
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of restrained sexuality and association with sex workers.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Historical gender/sexual morality rhetoric, not person-level inference.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mercury
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of cognitive perplexity and disputes involving words, writing and children.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Do not treat historic cognitive labels as diagnoses.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of the Moon
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of death danger, melancholy, cough and marital difficulties.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Explicit high-stakes health/death/marital allegation unvalidated.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: Jupiter returning to his owne place
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of a child, wealth, health and esteem.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Historic pregnancy/wealth claim unvalidated.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Saturn, if Saturn in the Radix promised good
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Source conditions purported gain or reduction on whether natal Saturn signifies good or ill.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: The natal-Saturn prior promise is an explicit branch.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mars, profit by Travels
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional gains through travel, commerce, soldiers and kin.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Period occupational classifications only.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Sun, a Feaver is threatened
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claim of fever but growing social honor.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Medical symptom not a clinical forecast.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Venus, it incites to Sobriety
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of sobriety and gains through women.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Historical gender-coded assertion.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mercury, given to study
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of study, religion and modest social ties.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Source morality classification not empirically established.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of the Moon, health of Body
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of bodily health, wealth, birth of a child if married, women, kin and travel.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Childbirth condition is explicitly if married in the historical text.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: Mars to the place of Saturn
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claims of travel, work delays, conflict, facial injury and harm to father.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Severe medical/family assertion unvalidated.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: Mars to the place of Jupiter
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional gains via kin, clergy and livestock.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Period livelihood categories only.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To his owne place, in danger by Fire
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional fire danger alongside gain through soldiers or friendship.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Risk claims are not modern hazard advice.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Sun, Captivity
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional captivity, elite anger and martial contention.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Legal/anger allegations not personal facts.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Venus, very Lustfull
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional sexual-morality and illness allegations.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Historic stigmatizing and medical claims unvalidated.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mercury, inclines to lying
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional accusations about speech, character and verbal disputes.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Source morality claims must not classify real people.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Moon, much given to Drink
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional allegations about drinking, travel and slander by women.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No verified addiction/relationship prediction.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: When in a Revolution, Venus comes to the place of Saturn
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical sexual desire/capacity claim with natal return-Venus combustion and fortunate/unfortunate conditions.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Source explicitly branches on combustion and Venus fortune; do not infer actual physiology.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Jupiter, friendship with Joviall men
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional friendship with Jupiter-associated people, estate gains and family visits.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Old source associations are not modern financial forecasts.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mars, shewes Marriage
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical claims of marriage inclination, gambling/sport and sexual conduct.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Source-specific historical marriage/sexual morality assertions.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Sun, oppressed with many cares
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical cares/jealousy; alternative promotion/reputation claim if natal Sun dignified.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Explicit conditional branch requires dignified Sun.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To her owne place, all things succeed well
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical claim of favorable outcomes, music and health.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Not empirical health/performance evidence.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mercury, and she well affected
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical learning/honor/social ties if returning Venus is well affected.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Explicit favorable-Venus condition.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of the Moon, it betters the condition
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional improvement in situation and new acquaintances.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No actual life event evidence.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Saturn, it brings in profit
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional gain from land work or older men.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Not an agricultural/financial forecast.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Jupiter, he aquires an Office
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical employment, office and commercial gain.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Period occupational rhetoric.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mars, he is theevish
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historic accusation of theft, quarrel and anger.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Criminality/moral label prohibited as person-level inference.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Sun, busied in Controversies
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional disputes and clerical honors.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Historic source meaning only.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Venus, much addicted to Poetry
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional arts, leisure, grooming and courtship interests.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Not proven personality characterization.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To his owne place, he receives preferment
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical self-effort or praise bringing advancement.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Not calibrated career probability.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Moon, employed in the occaseions
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional social assistance to friends and gains.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No observed validation.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Saturn, acquaintance with an aged Woman
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional claim of older-woman acquaintance, inheritance contention and news about women.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Period gender and estate claims unverified.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Jupiter, many Journeys
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional profitable travel and possible childbirth among married people.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Historic marital childbirth claim not a reproductive prediction.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mars, in danger of a Sickenesse
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional fever, irritability, travel danger and conflict.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Health and safety allegations explicitly unverified.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Sun, many hazards
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional flight/moving, hazard and eye trouble.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No modern medical risk prediction.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Venus, given to all manner of Pleasure
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional pleasure/health/contentment claims.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No human outcome verification.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To the place of Mercury, oft flitting
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Traditional relocation and gain through trade/merchandise.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: No predictive performance established.

records.modern_secondary_text_locator_non_diplom: To her owne place, she promises good
records.source_historical_meaning_only: Historical conditional: if natal Moon fortunate it promises good; if natal Moon weak it instead warns of ill.
records.source_original_natal_and_return_conditi: Explicit binary source branch on natal Moon fortune/weakness, not an empirical law.

physical_boundary_note.source_historical_meaning_only: Original Moon-on-Moon final conditional passage is followed by a horizontal divider, then separate CHAP CLXXIV, Of the Transit of the Planets.
